description: This file defines the class SearchThrowableHandler, which manages exceptions and errors during search operations in the SuiteCRM system. It provides user-friendly error messages and detailed debug information based on configuration.

classes.name: SearchThrowableHandler
classes.description: Handles exceptions and errors during search operations, providing error messages and detailed debugging info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the handler with a throwable and a search query.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Displays either a detailed stack trace or a user-friendly message based on configuration.

methods.name: getFriendlyMessage
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly error message based on the exception type.

methods.name: printStackTrace
methods.description: Uses the Whoops library to show a detailed exception page.

methods.name: getSearchWrapperStatus
methods.description: Collects search system status info for debugging purposes.

methods.name: printFriendlyMessage
methods.description: Displays a simple error message on the web page.
